mechanism: Furosemide reduces renal blood flow and glomerular filtration rate, potentially decreasing cefepime clearance and increasing antibiotic levels; cephalosporins may potentiate loop diuretic-induced nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities.
action: Monitor renal function (BUN, creatinine) and serum electrolytes regularly; adjust cefepime dosing if renal impairment develops; ensure adequate hydration and consider alternative diuretic if severe renal dysfunction occurs.
